GitHub Copilot (Chat, Agent mode, CLI, and cloud agent) lets users issue natural-language prompts like 'Update the website to allow searching for running races by name' and have Copilot plan and implement changes, and Copilot CLI brings this to the terminal directly (github-docs-2, 13, 23, 26, 48, 55).
